<documents>
<document id="travel-card-abroad">
UsingˆyourˆcardˆabroadˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆworksˆinˆmostˆcountries,ˆanywhereˆVisaˆisˆaccepted.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆgoˆ-ˆKeepˆnotificationsˆonˆforˆtheˆappˆsoˆyouˆcanˆanswerˆfraudˆalertsˆquickly.ˆ-ˆMakeˆsureˆInternationalˆpurchasesˆisˆswitchedˆonˆunderˆCards,ˆthenˆControls.ˆ-ˆCheckˆyourˆplan'sˆforeignˆtransactionˆandˆinternationalˆATMˆfees.ˆ-ˆAddˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆtoˆyourˆphone'sˆwalletˆasˆaˆbackup.ˆ##ˆWhatˆitˆcostsˆPurchasesˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrencyˆcarryˆaˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆofˆ3%ˆonˆBasic,ˆ1%ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ0%ˆonˆPremium.ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆabroadˆhaveˆtheirˆownˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆinstead.ˆ##ˆPayingˆinˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆWhenˆaˆcardˆterminalˆasksˆwhetherˆtoˆpayˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆorˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency,ˆchooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency.ˆ##ˆIfˆyourˆcardˆisˆlostˆabroadˆFreezeˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆreportˆit.ˆStandardˆandˆexpeditedˆshippingˆonlyˆgoˆtoˆUSˆaddresses.ˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆgetˆanˆemergencyˆcardˆdeliveredˆabroad.ˆEveryoneˆelseˆcanˆkeepˆspendingˆwithˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆinˆaˆmobileˆwallet.ˆDoˆyouˆneedˆtoˆtellˆusˆyou'reˆtraveling?ˆNo.ˆSeeˆ"DoˆIˆneedˆaˆtravelˆnotice?".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="cushion-negative-after-dispute">
NegativeˆbalanceˆafterˆaˆdisputeˆYourˆbalanceˆcanˆgoˆnegativeˆwhenˆweˆtakeˆbackˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆafterˆaˆdisputeˆisˆdenied,ˆorˆwhenˆaˆdepositˆisˆreturned.ˆThisˆisn'tˆCushion,ˆandˆitˆcanˆhappenˆonˆanyˆplan,ˆincludingˆBasic.ˆ##ˆWhyˆitˆhappensˆAˆprovisionalˆcreditˆisˆmoneyˆweˆlendˆyouˆwhileˆaˆdisputeˆisˆinvestigated.ˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆisˆdenied,ˆweˆgiveˆyouˆwrittenˆnoticeˆandˆtakeˆitˆbackˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆlater.ˆIfˆyou'veˆspentˆitˆinˆtheˆmeantime,ˆtheˆbalanceˆcanˆdropˆbelowˆzero.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆyourˆbalanceˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆAnyˆincomingˆdepositˆrepaysˆitˆautomatically.ˆ##ˆFeesˆThereˆareˆnoˆfeesˆforˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆ($0.00).ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆisn'tˆrepaidˆAsˆwithˆCushion,ˆifˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆlastsˆ60ˆdays,ˆtheˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆuntilˆit'sˆrepaid.ˆOnˆPlusˆandˆPremium,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspendedˆwhileˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆnegativeˆforˆlongerˆthanˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆCan'tˆpayˆitˆrightˆaway?ˆMessageˆsupport.ˆIfˆyou'reˆgoingˆthroughˆfinancialˆhardship,ˆweˆcanˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Do I need to set a travel notice before going to Mexico?
